messages:
Rae: quick question— prototype link: https://proto.redwood/dash-a11y-shortcuts. Users requested keyboard shortcuts (g to go to graphs, / to focus search). Need an a11y sanity check: focus traps, announcements, and contrast.

Diego: Good call. Two immediate red flags: 1) Shortcut handler focuses elements but doesn't skip inert elements (modals offscreen still tabbable), causing focus trap; 2) search input placeholder color is #8A8A8A on white -> ~3.6:1.

Lin: For shortcuts pattern: when invoking a shortcut that moves focus, ensure `inert` or `aria-hidden=true` on background content if a modal-like panel opens. For nav shortcuts like 'g' -> graphs, just do `document.getElementById('graphs').focus()` and set a short lived `aria-live='polite'` message like "Navigated to graphs" (but avoid duplicating title announce on route change).

A11yBot: automated-scan: issues=6; color-contrast(1), focus-trap(1), inert-missing(1), skip-link(1), aria-live(1), role(1). report: https://a11y.redwood/reports/1791209876.json

Diego: Also found keyboard shortcut help modal is announced twice because we call `role=dialog` and also update an aria-live region. Remove the live update; screen reader will announce dialog name. Ensure the dialog has `aria-modal=true` and focus is trapped correctly inside.

Lin: Implementation notes: use `dialog.showModal()` polyfill where needed; add `inert` to non-dialog siblings or `aria-hidden=true`. For search placeholder, change `--text-placeholder` to `#505050` to reach >=4.5:1 on white. For focus visuals, use `:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }`.

Rae: Good. Any thoughts on announcing shortcut keymap? We have a small on-screen list and an offscreen live region that reads "Shortcut menu opened".

Lin: Let the dialog announcement handle that. If you want an additional confirmation, keep the live region but only announce dynamic status like "Shortcut X activated" for one-off actions, not for opening the dialog.

QA: Acceptance criteria: 1) No focusable background when dialog open; 2) Dialog has role=dialog, aria-modal=true, labelledby; 3) Placeholder color >=4.5:1; 4) Shortcuts move focus predictably and announce a brief polite message when appropriate; 5) No duplicate SR announcements on dialog open. I'll add tests for focus trap and a short NVDA script.

Diego: Token updates: `--text-placeholder: #505050`, `--focus-accent: #0066CC`. I'll open a tiny PR with the placeholder change and dialog utilities.

Maya: Sounds good. Owners: Diego -> PR for placeholder and dialog utils; Lin -> doc for shortcuts behaviour + sample code; QA -> tests. Target PR by 1791800000. Reopen if anything blocks :thumbsup:
